svg.title: ContextVerity: trust the context before the agent does
svg.desc: ContextVerity records the context an agent received from Backstage and later verifies whether it is still current and allowed. Animated: when the owner changes the verdict is REFRESH (OWNER_CHANGED); when classification rises above the grant it is DENY (CLASSIFICATION_RAISED); with no relevant change it is VALID.
